textContent.text: Stick insects are a tasty snack for birds and other animals. But these bugs have a tricky way to hide. They look like sticks! They also don't move much. This makes them hard to spot in the trees where they live.

Some stick insects also have colorful wings that help keep them safe. They keep their wings closed until other animals come near. Then, the stick insects show their wings in a bright flash. This scares the animals away and gives the stick insects time to hide.

Stick insects have another neat trick. A stick insect can get away even if a bird catches it by the leg. The stick insect just lets its leg fall off! Luckily, stick insects can grow back any legs they lose.

textContent.text: Sea otters like to live near rocky beaches. They have fun playing on the rocks, but they like being in the cold water better.

Sea otters need a good way to stay warm in the water. This is why they have thick fur coats with two parts. The outside part has many long hairs. These long hairs keep the inside part of the coat dry, which helps otters stay warm.

Sea otters' fur coats also come with pockets! Sea otters have bags of skin under each front leg. They can carry things inside these pockets. Some otters keep rocks in there. They use the rocks to break open the shells of sea animals.
When sea otters hunt, they put the food they find into these pockets. Then they use their empty paws to catch more food!
